#include <iostream>

using namespace std;

typedef long long ll;
typedef pair<int, int> pii;
typedef vector<int> vi;
typedef vector<vector<int>> vvi;
typedef vector<vector<ll>> vvll;

const int INF = 1e9;

struct Edge {
    int from, to;
    int capacity;
    int cost;
    int flow;
    Edge* complement;
    
    Edge(int from, int to, int capacity, int cost) 
        : from(from), to(to), capacity(capacity), cost(cost), flow(0), complement(nullptr) {}
};

vector<vector<Edge*>> compileWD(int n, vector<Edge*>& edges) {
    // cloning
    for (int i = edges.size() - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
        Edge* origin = edges[i];
        Edge* clone = new Edge(origin->to, origin->from, origin->capacity, -origin->cost);
        clone->flow = origin->capacity;
        clone->complement = origin;
        origin->complement = clone;
        edges.push_back(clone);
    }
    
    vector<int> p(n, 0);
    for (Edge* e : edges) p[e->from]++;
    
    vector<vector<Edge*>> g(n);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        g[i].resize(p[i]);
    }
    
    vector<int> cnt(n, 0);
    for (Edge* e : edges) {
        g[e->from][cnt[e->from]++] = e;
    }
    return g;
}

ll solveMinCostFlow(vector<vector<Edge*>>& g, int source, int sink, ll all) {
    int n = g.size();
    ll mincost = 0;
    vector<int> potential(n, 0);
    
    vector<int> d(n);
    vector<Edge*> inedge(n, nullptr);
    vector<bool> inq(n, false);
    vector<int> dist(n);
    
    while (all > 0) {
        // shortest path src->sink using SPFA or Dijkstra with potentials
        fill(dist.begin(), dist.end(), INF);
        fill(inq.begin(), inq.end(), false);
        dist[source] = 0;
        
        queue<int> q;
        q.push(source);
        inq[source] = true;
        
        while (!q.empty()) {
            int cur = q.front();
            q.pop();
            inq[cur] = false;
            
            for (Edge* ne : g[cur]) {
                if (ne->capacity - ne->flow > 0) {
                    int nd = dist[cur] + ne->cost + potential[cur] - potential[ne->to];
                    if (dist[ne->to] > nd) {
                        dist[ne->to] = nd;
                        inedge[ne->to] = ne;
                        if (!inq[ne->to]) {
                            q.push(ne->to);
                            inq[ne->to] = true;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        
        if (dist[sink] == INF) break;
        
        ll minflow = all;
        ll sumcost = 0;
        for (Edge* e = inedge[sink]; e != nullptr; e = inedge[e->from]) {
            if (e->capacity - e->flow < minflow) minflow = e->capacity - e->flow;
            sumcost += e->cost;
        }
        mincost += minflow * sumcost;
        
        for (Edge* e = inedge[sink]; e != nullptr; e = inedge[e->from]) {
            e->flow += minflow;
            e->complement->flow -= minflow;
        }
        
        all -= minflow;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            if (dist[i] < INF) {
                potential[i] += dist[i];
            }
        }
    }
    return mincost;
}

int main() {
    ios_base::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    
    int n;
    cin >> n;
    
    string s;
    cin >> s;
    
    vector<int> f(26, 0);
    for (char c : s) f[c - 'a']++;
    
    for (int i = 0; i < 26; i++) {
        if (f[i] > n / 2) {
            cout << -1 << endl;
            return 0;
        }
    }
    
    vector<int> a(n);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        cin >> a[i];
    }
    
    for (int i = 0; i < n / 2; i++) {
        if (a[i] > a[n - 1 - i]) {
            swap(a[i], a[n - 1 - i]);
            swap(s[i], s[n - 1 - i]);
        }
    }
    
    vector<Edge*> edges;
    int src = n, sink = n + 1;
    
    for (int i = 0; i < n / 2; i++) {
        edges.push_back(new Edge(src, i, 1, 0));
        edges.push_back(new Edge(n - 1 - i, sink, 1, 0));
        for (int j = 0; j < n / 2; j++) {
            if (s[i] != s[n - 1 - j]) {
                int cost = (i == j) ? 0 : a[i];
                edges.push_back(new Edge(i, n - 1 - j, 1, cost));
            }
        }
    }
    
    ll ans = 0;
    for (int x : a) ans += x;
    
    vector<vector<Edge*>> graph = compileWD(sink + 1, edges);
    ll mincost = solveMinCostFlow(graph, src, sink, n / 2);
    
    cout << ans - mincost << endl;
    
    // Cleanup memory
    for (auto& vec : graph) {
        for (auto* e : vec) {
            delete e;
        }
    }
    
    return 0;
}
